content.title: Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge Urges Removal of BJP from Uttar Pradesh
content.caption: Mallikarjun Kharge, Congress president, urges the Samajwadi Party (SP)-Congress alliance to remove the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) from power in Uttar Pradesh.
